character: A man in his late fifties, very big and heavy through the shoulders, thickening with age. A broad weather-creased face, deep lines at the eyes, a full salt-and-pepper beard trimmed close. Thick grey-brown hair swept back. An old scar through one eyebrow. Heavy-lidded and level, watching
wardrobe: a heavy dark brown coat of good make, plain and unadorned but brushed clean and carefully kept, the cuffs worn smooth with long use, over a clean grey shirt, a leather cord at the collar, and solid well-polished boots

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing squarely, shoulders set, weight settled back, arms loose at his sides, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer directly, chin slightly lowered.

scene.framing: A guildmaster standing behind a heavy desk in a small cluttered upper floor office, maps pinned across the wall behind him, a shortsword lying on the desktop, one hand flat on a stack of papers, low lamplight, a narrow window showing a river bridge at dusk.
